0022600202.text: The Sacramento Kings (1-8, 0-4 at home, on a two-game losing streak) host the Miami Heat (3-6, on a one-game losing streak) in the Kings' 10th game of the 2026-27 season, with Sacramento 6.5 games back of the Pacific lead and Miami 2.5 games back in the Southeast. Ben Simmons (Achilles surgery), Keegan Murray (ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee) are out for the Kings, and De'Andre Hunter is day-to-day with an illness and is a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and they split their 2025-26 series 1-1, with the most recent meeting on January 20, 2026, in Sacramento, a 130-117 Kings loss.
